status: User accepted the 1 exact diagnostic sites on 2026-10-07. Focused qualification and its recorded limits are unchanged. Full RPM and native architecture qualification remain separate gates.
root_cause: The shared declaration template includes the anonymous default-export branch. PreParser does not initialize default-export strings because it is never called in that context. GCC nevertheless considers that branch, leaving variable_name.string_ potentially uninitialized in its analysis.
source_review: All declaration calls reachable by PreParser pass default_export=false, including ordinary, statement-list and async declaration wrappers. Their exact call sites are retained.

An unnamed declaration with default_export=false returns before DeclareFunction. A named declaration assigns variable_name from ParseIdentifier; GetIdentifier and EmptyIdentifierString both initialize string_.
Only Parser handles export-default declarations. Its GetDefaultStrings initializes both the display name and the synthetic binding name. PreParser GetDefaultStrings is deliberately empty.
The original PreParserIdentifier class, including its default constructor and private pointer field, is copied verbatim into the control.

coverage.matrix: Both template implementations, named/reserved/error tokens, missing names, normal/generator/async/async-generator flags, strict/sloppy modes, declaration/module/block scope, and valid Parser default exports. Both compiler modes normally and under Valgrind.
coverage.memory: Both native memory runs have zero errors and all allocations freed.
coverage.actual_node: Lazy and eager modes execute nested declarations with ASCII/Unicode/special identifiers, normal and async functions/generators, named/anonymous default exports and invalid declaration/module syntax. Function names, captures, values and generator completion are checked.

limits: The complete declaration function and identifier class are verbatim. Scanner, scope, AST and symbol-table operations use typed adapters; their key pointer-initialization contracts are reviewed separately in source.
The control does not invoke PreParser with default_export=true: no reviewed call site permits that combination. This qualification does not certify misuse of that internal template API.
Native reserved/error-token cases validate initialized pointer flow, not the entire parser error machinery. Actual JavaScript tests cover language syntax rejection.
No runtime patch, suppression or compiler-flag change is proposed.
